label: wave
definition: The set of issues that can run at once: no open blocker among them, file-disjoint, within the session budget. cckit plan lays the open work into waves by its blocked_by edges; cckit orchestrate runs one wave in parallel worktrees; cckit watch merges it and advances to the next.
is_not: An effort: an effort is one goal; a wave is a layer of the dependency graph and may hold issues from several efforts.
A sprint: a wave has no dates, it ends when its PRs merge.
The whole plan: the plan is the ordered list of waves.
avoid: round (a round is one agent pass inside autopilot run)
